admission.lowering: The exact block reuses the production-qualified signed bit-string read path and feeds its CF-only lazy descriptor into the backward above-or-equal branch.
admission.boundedRule: The measured RIP, complete ten-byte two-instruction block, RAX+0x228 memory base, qword width, RBX index, JAE condition, and both branch targets must all match. An adjacent RIP or changed condition declines.

verification.focusedGate: The exact RBX/RAX memory-BT block passes its tier-one differential and failed-read matrix.
verification.dbtPCAndRunnerGate: 1,498 tests in 175 suites passed; the pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent.
verification.differentialCoverage: Signed indices 0, 64, and -1, both old-bit states, complete state, unchanged memory, CF, and backward/forward branch destinations match the interpreter.
verification.faultCoverage: An unmapped source read preserves complete block-entry state.
verification.negativeCoverage: An adjacent RIP and a changed branch condition both decline tier one.

unmatchedPriorRunComparison.interpretation: The executions have different interrupt, compilation, trace, address-space, and instruction totals. Exact-site absence establishes production use; aggregate and elapsed movements are reported for completeness and are not a performance claim.
